notes.title: New update - Options menu and other bug fixes
notes.content:
Main menu - options.

Drag a slider that will influence the sensitivity of flight controls.

Fixed mouse cursor invisible on mission success menu.

Fixed plane static on reaching height limit.

Fixed roll sound disable on two trolls (level 9)

Cave mission - Delete one of two copters.

Copters will now delay spawning when destroyed.


I hope these edits will make the experience much better.
Cheers!

Peter
Magnetic Studio

notes.content:
Update in the works. Going to add an option button in the main menu which will allow the player adjust the sensitivity of controls. Tweaking other things like game balance, difficulty and plane behaviour when reaching height limits.

Thanks in advance for your patience. 

Peter
